facts.fact: INTIC says the free government digital signature service SCDM, at assinadoravancado.gov.mz, lets accredited users sign and verify electronic documents and is in use.
facts.system: Sistema de Certificacao Digital de Mocambique (SCDM)

facts.fact: INTIC says SCDM is in use at more than 10 public institutions, including the Imprensa Nacional, the Supreme Court and the Balcao de Atendimento Unico, between mid-2023 and end-2024.
facts.system: Sistema de Certificacao Digital de Mocambique (SCDM)

systems.system: Sistema de Certificacao Digital de Mocambique (SCDM)
systems.platform: assinadoravancado.gov.mz; built with Brazil's LabSEC under a 2022 MoU

facts.fact: INTIC's chair says the digital certification service is part of the Politica e Estrategia Nacional de Seguranca Cibernetica.
facts.system: Politica e Estrategia Nacional de Seguranca Cibernetica

facts.fact: INTIC says Law no. 3/2017 and Decree no. 59/2019 give digital signatures the same legal validity as physical ones.
INTIC says the SCDM digital signature system is implemented and managed by Mozambican professionals, cutting dependence on external consultants.
INTIC offers the SCDM signature service free to government, and more than 10 public institutions use it.
